review.source: PHEBS-42 binds phebs.thrift.caller.go to thrift-contract@1.1.2 plus thrift-caller@1.6.0-released.1. Admission matrix covers dark, alone, beside the protobuf caller family, beside the Thrift Atlas, revoked, suspended, expired and an unsupported claim version; name-matching consumer domains are never registered.
review.evidence: Dark and released Thrift caller facts are byte-identical over the t201 profile while candidate policy, caller generation and extractor-set digests change. A published thrift-caller generation is served end to end by the exact Caller Map with resolved rows and a bound citation. The T21.14 committed fixture joins a Thrift caller to its declaration lineage.
review.security: Existing authenticated visibility/source/generation/citation fences, signed binary/artifact bindings and identity checks retained. Caller comparison and operation Impact keep refusing non-protobuf endpoints under their released claims.
review.steady_state_cost: A dark install registers nothing new. A released install adds one extractor pair to the existing candidate, resolver, caller and publication pipeline; no new worker, cache, lock, child, timer, index or schema, and no ceiling raised.
